scope: Third-party art, sound and photographic color references. See geographic documentation for terrain, road, water and other GIS data provenance.
meaning_of_included: A local file exists and is listed with a checksum; this does not assert every available file is instantiated or played at runtime.
human_source_policy: Prioritize identifiable human modeling, photography and field recording. Source-derived technical conversion/rendering is recorded. Candidates with unresolved provenance remain conditional.

Lower LODs decimate wood; LOD2 omits small dead branches.
